!Sample_taxid_ch1	9606

!Sample_scan_protocol	GeneChips were scanned using the diagnostic-grade Affymetrix scanner 3000DX
!Sample_data_processing	Probe intensities were quantified with Microarray Suite version 5.0 (MAS 5.0) using Affymetrix default analysis settings.
